{{Quote|Will the owner of a red and black landspeeder vehicle ID THX-1138 please return to your craft. You're parked in a no-hover area.|Female announcer|<ref name="Star Tours (real-world)">[[Star Tours (real-world)|''Star Tours'']]</ref>}}
A '''no-hover area''' was a place where vehicles should not be parked.

The [[THX 1138 (landspeeder)|THX 1138]] [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]] once parked outside a [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency starport, prompting a public address announcer to warn the owner.
